claims.statement: The three required viewports are 1280px desktop, 390px mobile, and 320px narrow; the 320px run is required when content density, long Vietnamese text, full VND amounts, tables, dialogs, or sheets could overflow.

The desktop+mobile parity contract requires mutation calls, query keys, authorization, filter/sort/error states, and action reachability to be identical across both views, with mobile actions reachable via sheet, menu, or footer within 44px touch targets.
Admin and Partner must be tested independently at both desktop and mobile; the employee role is mobile-first and many flows have no desktop surface so the 1280px run is not required there.
frontend/src/pages/admin/list-error-parity.test.tsx is the desktop/mobile list-error parity contract test for the admin role.

Per-role login fixtures seed a known user per role against the dev DB (docker-compose.dev.yml); clock control is exercised via /api/v1/admin/clock/advance (non-prod only) and the full 3-viewport × 3-role × ~20-scenario matrix runs in CI on every PR.
